content_sections.heading: JCSTI Recruitment 2026 Quick Facts
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: Jharkhand Council on Science, Technology and Innovation (JCSTI), Ranchi
Mechanical, Civil, Electrical and Computer Engineering / Computer Science Engineering
Rs. 15,000 per month (Graduate Apprentice); Rs. 10,000 per month (Technician Apprentice)
Graduates / diploma holders in the above fields from Jharkhand State institutions, passed 2024 to 2026

content_sections.heading: About JCSTI
content_sections.text: The Jharkhand Council on Science, Technology and Innovation (JCSTI) works under the Department of Higher and Technical Education, Government of Jharkhand. Its office is at Yojna Bhawan, Nepal House Campus, Doranda, Ranchi, Jharkhand - 834002. The apprentices will be engaged at JCSTI under the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme and the provisions of the Apprentices Act, 1961 (as amended).

content_sections.heading: Seats by Trade
content_sections.text: JCSTI has 6 apprentice seats in total. The category-wise break-up is as printed in the notice: The fields covered are Mechanical, Civil, Electrical and Computer Engineering / Computer Science Engineering. The notice does not split the seats by individual engineering branch.

rows.establishment: Jharkhand Council on Science, Technology and Innovation
rows.stipend_per_month_inr: 15000 for Graduate Apprentice (Engineering) and 10000 for Technician Apprentice

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who have graduated / passed diploma in the field of Mechanical, Civil, Electrical and Computer Engineering / Computer Science Engineering from any recognized University/College/Polytechnic of Jharkhand State between the years 2024 to 2026 are eligible to apply. Graduate Apprentice (Engineering): graduated in one of the above fields. Technician Apprentice: passed diploma in one of the above fields. The institution must be in Jharkhand State, and the year of passing must fall between 2024 and 2026. Refer to the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post. Graduate Apprentice (Engineering): 01 SC and 01 ST. Technician Apprentice: 02 UR, 01 ST and 01 BC-I. In addition, 01 seat each under Graduate and Technician Apprentice shall be horizontally reserved for Divyangjan applicants.

content_sections.heading: Stipend and Training Period
content_sections.text: The apprentices are selected for a one-year period. The monthly stipend is shared between JCSTI and the Board of Practical Training (BoPT): JCSTI shall only be responsible for payment of its share of the stipend and bears no responsibility for payment of the BoPT share of the monthly stipend. The engagement is valid for one (01) year only from the date of generation of the Apprenticeship Contract. Selected candidates will be awarded a Certificate of Proficiency (CoP) by the Board of Practical Training, Eastern Region, on successful completion of 1 year of apprenticeship training. The engagement is purely temporary and does not confer any right or claim, explicitly or implicitly, for regular appointment in any post of JCSTI.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JCSTI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted online only, through the link given in the notice: https://dhteapprenticeship.jharkhand.gov.in/register . The application window runs from 4 November 2026 to 1 December 2026, 11:59 PM. The notice does not describe the form-filling steps. Documents named in the notice: All original certificates – to be produced by shortlisted candidates at the time of the personal interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is by shortlisting, a Personal Interview and a final merit list based on a cumulative score. Shortlisted candidates will be called for a Personal Interview at a place to be communicated in due course of time. The final selection is based on the cumulative score, combining the percentage of marks in the qualifying examination (Diploma/Degree) and the Personal Interview in the ratio of 70:30 respectively. The Personal Interview carries a maximum of 100 marks. Formula: Cumulative Score = (0.7 × Percentage of Marks obtained in Qualifying Examination) + (0.3 × Marks obtained by candidate in Personal Interview). Illustration from the notice: with 70% in the qualifying degree and 60 marks in the Personal Interview, the cumulative score is (0.7 × 70) + (0.3 × 60) = 49 + 18 = 67.

faq.question: Q1. How many apprentice seats are there in JCSTI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 seats: 2 Graduate Apprentice (Engineering) and 4 Technician Apprentice.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the JCSTI apprentice posts?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online applications is 1 December 2026, 11:59 PM. Applications opened on 4 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for JCSTI Graduate and Technician Apprentice?
faq.answer: Candidates must have graduated / passed diploma in Mechanical, Civil, Electrical and Computer Engineering / Computer Science Engineering from a recognized University/College/Polytechnic of Jharkhand State between 2024 and 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the stipend for JCSTI apprentices?
faq.answer: Graduate Apprentice (Engineering) gets Rs. 15,000 a month (Rs. 10,500 JCSTI share and Rs. 4,500 BoPT share), and Technician Apprentice gets Rs. 10,000 a month (Rs. 6,000 JCSTI share and Rs. 4,000 BoPT share).

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for JCSTI Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through https://dhteapprenticeship.jharkhand.gov.in/register by 1 December 2026, 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q6. How will JCSTI select apprentices?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates attend a Personal Interview of 100 marks, and the final selection is on a cumulative score combining qualifying examination percentage and interview marks in the ratio 70:30.

faq.question: Q7. When is the JCSTI apprentice interview?
faq.answer: The Personal Interview is on 9 December 2026, after the shortlist is published on 4 December 2026. The venue will be communicated in due course.

faq.question: Q8. Is the JCSTI apprenticeship a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely temporary, valid for one year from the generation of the Apprenticeship Contract, and gives no claim to regular appointment in JCSTI.

faq.question: Q9. Are any seats reserved for Divyangjan candidates?
faq.answer: Yes. 01 seat each under Graduate and Technician Apprentice is horizontally reserved for Divyangjan applicants.

faq.question: Q10. Who pays the BoPT share of the stipend?
faq.answer: JCSTI pays only its own share of the stipend and bears no responsibility for payment of the BoPT share.
